title: Clean vs Messy Setups
hook: Valid isn’t the same as wanted.

launchpad.outcome: Grade four setups with three separate labels: validity, quality, and the decision.
launchpad.missionQuestion: Which ICC do I actually want?

slides.headline: Valid isn’t the same as wanted.
slides.line: Four 1-minute charts at a PIL. Is each one a clean setup you want, or a messy one you leave alone?

minis.title: Chart A · Long
minis.ctx: 1H trending up · room to the next high
minis.why: One close through, one pullback, one Continuation. The level is respected.

minis.title: Chart B · Long
minis.why: Price closes across the PIL over and over. Nothing is holding.

minis.title: Chart C · Short
minis.ctx: 1H trending down · room to the next low
minis.why: Close below, pullback above, close below again, then follow-through.

minis.title: Chart D · Long
minis.why: Long wicks both ways and no direction. Your stop would sit inside the noise.

slides.headline: Three labels. Keep them separate.
slides.do: Chart B technically printed an I → C → C. Give it all three labels.

rows.label: Validity
rows.why: The closes happened, so the rules were met.

rows.label: Quality
rows.why: A choppy level and no room: questionable.

rows.label: Decision
rows.why: Valid isn’t the same as wanted.

slides.after: VALID + C + PASS is a real combination.

slides.headline: What makes it messy

cards.title: Closes back and forth across the PIL
cards.text: The level isn’t holding, so an Indication means very little.

cards.title: Long wicks, no direction
cards.text: Your stop would sit in the middle of the noise.

cards.title: The 1H is between structure
cards.text: No clear room to run, so no clean target.

slides.dayli: The goal isn’t to find ICC everywhere. It’s to know which ICC you actually want.

takeaways: Validity is method compliance. Quality is a contextual review. Keep them separate.
A / B / C are review labels, not trading signals.
VALID + C + PASS is a real combination.
remember: The goal isn’t to find ICC everywhere. The goal is to know which ICC you actually want.
